description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a Discover screen that allows users to search for books via a backend service. It manages user input, displays loading indicators, shows search results, and enables adding books to a library.

classes.name: DiscoverScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the discover/search screen.

classes.name: _DiscoverScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the state for DiscoverScreen, handling user input, search, and UI updates.

methods.name: _onSearch
methods.description: Handles search query submission; triggers backend search if the input is not empty.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the discover screen, including search bar, loading indicator, no results message, and list of search results.
